source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: At startup the application loads the file priv/release_ets/2026d.v2.ets into an ETS table queried by tzdata.ex and time_zone_database.ex. The release_updater downloads new versions and the data_builder converts them into periods with the parser and the period_builder.
